name: genpark-contextual-memory-pruning-importance-attributor-skill
description: Autonomous Long-Horizon Agentic Memory Pruning & Importance Attributor. Evaluates multi-turn episodic memory buffers, calculates multi-factor salience scores (recency decay, user priority pinning, emotional valence, and entity graph connectivity), and deterministically prunes low-utility noise to respect model context limits.

tools.name: prune_agentic_memory
tools.description: Calculate episodic memory importance attribution scores, identify redundant or decayed context nodes, and prune memory buffers to target token constraints.

memories.description: List of memory nodes with content, timestamp, is_pinned, access_count.

target_token_budget.description: Max allowable token budget for retained memory.

half_life_hours.description: Exponential recency decay half-life in hours.
